title: Add command task runtime guardrails and cancellation finalization
description: Implement control-plane guardrails for long-running command evaluations so tasks cannot loop invisibly and cancellation becomes deterministic. Scope: enforce bounded retry budgets at command step and item level with no unbounded nested retries. Scope: add stale-progress watchdog semantics based on heartbeat and progress deltas rather than fixed wall-clock timeout. Scope: enforce cancellation SLA by acknowledging cancel request and forcing terminal cancellation when grace window expires. Scope: surface machine-readable failure and cancellation reasons in Task status updates for UI clarity. Acceptance: local tests prove retries stop at configured budget. Acceptance: local tests prove stale-progress transitions to terminal failure with explicit reason. Acceptance: local tests prove cancel request reaches terminal cancelled state even if worker dies. Acceptance: staging run demonstrates visible terminal state transitions without indefinite Processing.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Execution plan to get back on rails: (1) normalize branch flow by promoting feature/command-service-integration into develop and making develop the only base for subsequent slices; (2) implement guardrails as three narrow slices with tests first: bounded retries, stale-progress watchdog, cancellation finalization; (3) require local command-service preflight + focused contract tests before each develop PR so staging is confirmation, not discovery.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Staging verification against task cmd_da8fe507... found repeated worker runtime errors while UI stayed in Generating predictions: sqlite3 OperationalError 'attempt to write a readonly database' from LangChain full_llm_cache inserts. Root cause is cache initialization occurring after our earlier preflight guard, so later SQLite cache creation can still bind to a non-writable relative path. Implemented next slice fix: executor now switches command runtime cwd to a writable directory (default /tmp, configurable via PLEXUS_WORKER_RUNTIME_DIR) for the command invocation window, then restores prior cwd. Added regression test proving a command launched from a read-only cwd can still initialize default SQLiteCache successfully in writable runtime dir, plus existing cache guard tests. Validation: pytest tests/command_worker/test_plexus_cli_executor.py tests/command_worker/test_task_gateway_contract.py.
